scientific_integrity: The global infinite-support statement follows from a rational finite certificate, a proved uniform tail bound, and strict polynomial monotonicity. Computations use standard-library exact fractions and are reproducible.
scientific_limitations: Exact first modal departures are established for orders 2 through 15 only; later transitions and higher orders are not classified. Publication priority beyond inspected sources remains subject to independent verification.
title: The first failure of the \(0\)-then-\(k\) Poisson mode rule occurs at order fifteen
